# BulletinBoard — Project Context

This is "Dorfplatz", a community bulletin board site (events, goods, services, chat) that is expected to keep growing in members and content over time. Keep that evolution in mind:

- Prefer the simplest solution that solves the problem. Avoid speculative abstractions, extra layers, or configurability that isn't asked for.
- See [.github/instructions/backend-testing.instructions.md](.github/instructions/backend-testing.instructions.md) for backend test requirements.
- See [.github/instructions/frontend-design-consistency.instructions.md](.github/instructions/frontend-design-consistency.instructions.md) for UI consistency rules.
- See [.github/instructions/scalable-lists.instructions.md](.github/instructions/scalable-lists.instructions.md) for how to build lists that stay usable as content grows.
